summary: Backend: 29/29 pytest tests PASSED covering auth, intervenants CRUD, availability flows (set/keep/unavailable), callbacks, admin moderation. Sophie Martin confirmed available_today=true and 5 seeded intervenants visible. Frontend: Home loads with both CTAs, /patient page renders map + list + filters + disclaimer 'Disponibilités déclarées par l'intervenant', Sophie/Lucas/Camille/Julien/Emma all visible with availability badges. Admin login (admin@apaconnect.fr/admin123) redirects to /admin dashboard showing all 6 intervenants with Validate/Hide actions. Intervenant register/login pages render correctly.
action_items: Optional: add data-testid attributes to filter buttons (filter-available-today, filter-available-week, filter-home, filter-verified) and to register form submit button for more robust automation. Functionality works fine via text selectors.
Optional: console shows 401 from /api/auth/me on public pages (expected when not logged in) - could be silenced by skipping the call when no token in localStorage.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET correctly read from env without default (fails fast).

CORS allow_credentials=True with allow_origins=['*'] - browsers reject this combo for credentialed XHR; works here because allow_origin_regex='.*' is also set. Functional but worth making origins explicit.
No brute-force lockout implemented on /api/auth/login (playbook recommends 5-fail lockout). Not blocking for MVP.
seed_admin correctly updates password if changed (idempotent).
Availability 'available_today' rule and 'available_this_week' gating verified to work correctly.
test_credentials: admin@apaconnect.fr / admin123 (admin); test intervenants registered dynamically with TEST_intervenant_<uuid>@apaconnect.fr / Test1234!
seed_data_creation: Tests register fresh TEST_-prefixed intervenants each run; 5 fake Rouen intervenants are auto-seeded by backend on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_apa_connect.py covers all 17 endpoints. Re-run with: pytest backend/tests/test_apa_connect.py -v.
